title: crystal-bci: crystallization-learned templates for fail-closed biosignal commands (SYNTHETIC)
description:
SYNTHETIC. Applies membrane-crystallization findings to biosignal commands: a peak-triggered Hebbian learner extracts a blink template (the crystal) unsupervised from a noisy synthetic multichannel stream, and a Youden-calibrated fail-closed gate turns blinks into a 'next' command. Multi-seed measurements (20 seeds): mean cosine about 0.67, mean hit rate about 0.96; the learned crystal beats a fixed template on average, while seed-7 perfect rates are above the mean. Synthetic signals only; not a medical device; not evaluated on human recordings; the device-data adapter is still missing.

Acknowledgement: builds on membrane-crystallization; Mun Seok Lee credited on that related package. No endorsement implied.
